messages:
Ava: Quick check  I uploaded the near-final launch post (drive link) and need two quick things: benchmark phrasing and CTA routing for webinar leads. Target publish Thu 09:00 PT.

Priya: On bench phrasing  please move the numeric claim to the subhead and hedge with 'up to'. Add a single-line method note (avg tokens, batching enabled).

Ava: Will change to subhead: 'Up to 2.5x lower token cost in our internal benchmarks' and add method footnote: 'avg request ~120 tokens; continuous batching + KV prefix cache; medians over 10k requests.'

Jon: Legal prefers 'up to' + disclaimer 'results may vary by workload'. @LegalBot please confirm.

LegalBot: Automated check: hedged phrasing acceptable. Add methodology link and disclaimer. No customer names.

Marco: CTA routing plan: split flows for (1) attended, (2) registered but no-show, (3) blog click only. Pseudocode to attach to CTA: 

```
if (event==='attended') { hubspot.flow='live_attendees'; utm_campaign='launch_live'; }
else if (event==='registered_no_show') { hubspot.flow='replay_nurture'; utm_campaign='launch_replay'; }
else { hubspot.flow='general_inbound'; utm_campaign='launch_blog'; }
// tag contact: lead_source=launch_blog
```

Lina: UX: primary CTA 'Register for webinar', secondary 'Technical notes'. Mobile: stack buttons; put replay link early in body.

Ava: Added UTM defaults (utm_source=blog, utm_medium=post) and contact tag. Inserted CTA snippet into CMS action.

Ava: Publish checklist for @PublishBot: final copy in CMS, hero image on CDN, HubSpot webhook wired, social scheduled. Can you run a smoke webhook at publish and confirm?

PublishBot: Smoke test scheduled 2026-06-03T16:00:00Z. Will post pass/fail here. :robot_face:

PublishBot: Smoke webhook PASS at 2026-06-03T16:02:12Z  sample payload routed to flow 'live_attendees'.

Jon: Final read: headline + subhead good. Minor copy change: use 'production-ready' in body.

Ava: Changed and pushed final to CMS. Legal signoff noted in doc. Planning to publish per schedule. Thanks everyone! :tada:
